input: I have 6 nurses who must cover 3 shifts per day (morning, afternoon, night) for one week. Each nurse can work at most 40 hours per week. At least 2 nurses must be on each shift. Find any valid schedule.
Four employees need to cover morning and evening shifts for 5 days. Each employee works at most 3 shifts total. Every shift needs exactly one employee. Find a feasible assignment.

Three workers (Alice, Bob, Carol) cover day and night shifts for 4 days. Each shift needs one worker. Each worker can do at most 3 shifts. Minimize the total number of shifts worked across all workers.

Five staff members must cover Saturday and Sunday, each day has morning and evening shifts. Each person works at most one shift per day and at most 3 shifts total across the weekend. At least one person per shift. Find any feasible schedule.
Eight nurses, two shifts per day (AM and PM) for 3 days. Each nurse works at most 2 shifts. Each shift needs at least 2 nurses. Find a valid schedule.
Two nurses must cover 3 shifts per day for 7 days. Each shift requires 3 nurses. Each nurse can work at most 1 shift per week. Find a schedule.
One delivery van starts at depot 0, must visit customers 1, 2, and 3, and return to the depot. Distances: 0-1=10, 0-2=15, 0-3=20, 1-2=5, 1-3=10, 2-3=5 (symmetric). Minimize total travel distance.
Knapsack capacity 10. Items: A weight 3 value 4, B weight 5 value 7, C weight 6 value 8, D weight 2 value 3. Maximize total value without exceeding capacity.
